name: Holoeyes Biz
summary:
Holoeyes Biz is a solution service for businesses that provides the opportunity to experience operating and viewing 3DCG content in XR space.
The organ models in the XR content utilize medical image data taken with CT or MRI, allowing for more realistic viewing from all angles.
